output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discontinued_net_revenue
FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l
JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id
WHERE o.is_revenue
  AND p.is_active = FALSE
output.explanation: Sums line net amounts (after discounts, excluding shipping) for discontinued products (is_active = false), counting only completed orders. It covers all data in the warehouse, 2024-01-01 to 2025-12-31. "Discontinued" reflects the product's current status, so sales made before a product was discontinued are included.
